note: Falkland Islands, read on the Falkland Islands Government's Customs & Immigration Service pages (gov.fk/customs) on 2026-10-30, under the Immigration Ordinance 1999. Anyone without Falkland Islands Status or a Permanent Residence Permit needs a work permit to take employment; it is applied for from outside the Islands (unless one held a permit in the last three months or lives there on another's permit), is ordinarily valid for the contract's length, is job and employer specific (work for the sponsor), and may be extended to no more than four years in all; the employer advertises the post locally and sponsors repatriation. A visitor may be let work under a short-term work permission for at most three months in twelve. The Permanent Residence Permit gives permanent residence free from immigration restrictions, asks at least three years' residence (3 kept as the work permit's years to it) and enough points in a points-based assessment; it is read as applied for in the Islands, since it asks years there. No fee or decision time is on the pages; Falkland Islands Status and naturalisation's years aren't written.

sources.title: Falkland Islands Government, Work Permit
sources.said: Work permits must be applied for from outside of the Falkland Islands unless the applicant: ... A work permit is ordinarily valid for the length of the individual’s contract and is job and employer specific. The period of validity of a work permit may be extended but must not exceed four years in total. ... Be prepared and to signify sponsorship and responsibility for full repatriation costs of the individual

sources.title: Falkland Islands Government, Working in the Falkland Islands
sources.said: Anyone who does not have Falkland Islands Status or a Falkland Islands Permanent Residence Permit (PRP) needs a work permit to undertake employment in the Falkland Islands.

sources.title: Falkland Islands Government, Permanent Residence Permit
sources.said: This permit allows permanent residence in the Falkland Islands, free from immigration restrictions. It requires prospective applicants meet essential criteria and achieve sufficient points through a points-based assessment. ... residency in the Falkland Islands for a minimum of 3 years for the applicant and any dependents included in the application

sources.title: Falkland Islands Government, FAQ & General Information
sources.said: Current rules only allow a visitor to work in the Islands for a maximum of three months in aggregate in any period of twelve months.
